If a firm pollutes more, it pays additional tax directly in proportion to the rise in emissions. ① The polluter thus has an incentive to reduce emissions in any manner that is less costly per unit of abatement than the tax on each unit of residual emissions. ② The great attraction of basing the tax directly on measured emissions is that the actions the polluter can take to reduce tax liability are actions that also reduce emissions. ③ Continuous emissions measurement can be costly, particularly where there are many separate sources of emissions, and for many pollution problems this may be a major disincentive to direct taxation of emissions. ④ In the future, it may be possible to think of taxing measured emissions in a wider range of applications. ⑤

paragraphs.label: (A)
paragraphs.text: That's $14.80 less, for a total of $133.20. Then, next month, see if you can bring that expense down by 10 percent again to $119.88. By introducing incremental shifts instead of huge, radical changes, you're more likely to stick with your new, moderately reduced habits.

paragraphs.label: (B)
paragraphs.text: Instead of forcing yourself to go entirely without, reduce spending on that category by just 10 percent each month. You won't see sudden, drastic change in your budget, but the shift will be a lot easier to stomach.

paragraphs.label: (C)
paragraphs.text: Say you spent $148 at coffee shops last month. The idea of never buying coffee is enough to make you want to hide from your budget forever, but what if you challenged yourself to spend just 10 percent less on coffee this month?

wrongOptionExplanations.2: (B) 다음에 구체 예시 없이 (A)의 That's $14.80 less 계산이 이어지면 기준 금액이 없어 지시 관계가 깨진다.
wrongOptionExplanations.3: (C)의 커피 예시가 먼저 오면 앞서 제시된 10% 감축 원칙 없이 숫자만 나와 방법 안내 흐름이 거꾸로 된다.

accepted.passageWithUnderline: Historically, drafters of tax legislation are attentive to questions of economics and history, and less attentive to moral questions. Questions of morality are often pushed to the side in legislative debate, labeled too controversial, too difficult to answer, or, worst of all, irrelevant to the project. But, in fact, the moral questions of taxation are at the very heart of the creation of tax laws. Rather than irrelevant, moral questions are fundamental to the imposition of tax. Tax is the application of a society's theories of distributive justice. Economics can go a long way towards helping a legislature determine whether or not a particular tax law will help achieve a particular goal, but economics cannot, __in a vacuum__, identify the goal. Creating tax policy requires identifying a moral goal, which is a task that must involve ethics and moral analysis.

accepted.passageWithUnderline: Garcia stood outside Frontcountry Mall, waiting for his brother, Jeff. Garcia's band had been chosen to perform at the welcoming ceremony for a large group of students from their sister university in Singapore. Garcia was hoping to find the perfect clothing for the performance. That was why he had asked Jeff to help him pick out new clothes. "I'm sorry. I'm late because traffic was terrible," Jeff apologized as he arrived. "Don't worry. I haven't waited long," Garcia replied as they entered the lively shopping center. "Aren't these cool?" Garcia asked, pointing at a patterned red shirt and yellow pants he had found in the store. "Um, I think they're a bit too colorful," Jeff objected. Instead, Jeff picked out a white shirt and black jeans. He asked the store clerk, "Don't you think these would look great on my brother?" The clerk stopped her work and looked at the clothes, quickly agreeing with Jeff's choice. Garcia bought the recommended clothes, saying, "Maybe I'll wear these for tonight's rehearsal, too." Garcia felt good as he arrived at the concert hall for the rehearsal wearing his new clothes. His confidence was, however, quickly changed to nervousness when he thought of how many people would be there. As the rehearsal began, he struggled with the rhythm, making several mistakes. Tom, Garcia's band mate, came over and put a hand on Garcia's back, saying, "Don't worry, __I'll be right behind you__." He looked at his friend, took a deep breath and started to feel much better. The band performance was the first event of the ceremony. The host introduced the band, and each member took their place on stage. Garcia stood at the center of the stage. As he started playing, everyone fell silent, fascinated by the music. Garcia's trumpet playing was flawless. When the band was finished, the audience loudly cheered. After the show, Jeff approached Garcia. "It was fantastic. I think that was the best performance I've ever seen," he said. Garcia beamed with joy at his brother's praise.

sentences: The very features that create expertise in a specialized domain lead to ignorance in many others.
In some cases lay people ― farmers, fishermen, patients, native peoples ― may have relevant experiences that scientists can learn from.
Indeed, in recent years, scientists have begun to recognize this: the Arctic Climate Impact Assessment includes observations gathered from local native groups.
These experts, having devoted their lives to tough questions about the natural world, can properly speak for the public on any matter linked to that world.

But without some degree of trust in our designated experts ― the men and women who have devoted their lives to sorting out tough questions about the natural world we live in ― we are paralyzed, in effect not knowing whether to make ready for the morning commute or not.

accepted.explanation: 지문은 1914년 세계대전 발발 시 세이거가 프랑스를 지키기 위해 프랑스군에 자원입대했고, 전쟁 중에 「I Have a Rendezvous with Death」를 써서 그 시가 발표되자 즉각 유명해졌다고 한다. 따라서 시로 먼저 유명해진 뒤에 1914년 입대했다는 3번은 시간 순서를 뒤집은 왜곡이다. 다른 선지는 출생·멕시코 기간·하버드·파리·전사 후 훈장 수여 등 지문의 구체적인 사실·순서를 그대로 패러프레이즈한 일치 진술이다.
keyPoints: 인물 전기형 지문은 출생→이동→학업→활동→전쟁→사후 순서를 정확히 대조한다
유명세·입대 시점은 ‘during the war’와 ‘in 1914’ 단서로 전후 관계를 확인한다
불일치 킬러 선지는 사실을 새로 만들지 않고 시간·인과만 미세 왜곡한다

wrongOptionExplanations.2: (A)는 맞지만, personal flair는 소품 범주의 필요 조건일 뿐 대규모 집단 작업에서 창의성만큼 중요한 요소로 제시된 것이 아니다.
wrongOptionExplanations.3: (B)는 맞지만, 개성 중시는 교육·담론에서 흔한 경향이지 반드시 불가피한(inevitable) 필연으로 결론짓지 않는다.

accepted.explanation: 지문은 소형·저복잡성 제품에서는 personal flair가 필수임을 인정하면서도, 대규모 프로젝트에서는 다수 디자이너가 개념을 구현하므로 ‘individuality 강조’가 문제적(problematic)이라고 본다. 성공한 designer personalities는 실제 단독 설계자보다 creative managers로 기능하며, 집단 작업에서는 management organization and processes가 창의성만큼 중요하다고 결론짓는다. 따라서 요약문의 평가 항은 problematic, 대비·보완 항은 management organization이 된다.

accepted.insertionRationale: 직전 (You are correct.)가 ‘cannot’ 확신을 확인해 since 인과 앞 고리를 닫고, 직후 소용돌이 문장이 you quit 결과를 받아 뒤 고리를 닫아 양방향 응집이 성립한다.

wrongOptionExplanations.1: ‘you cannot do’의 선행 내용이 아직 도입되지 않아 since 절의 인과 고리가 성립하지 않고, 뒤에 이어지는 cling 행위와도 순서·단서가 어긋난다.
wrongOptionExplanations.2: delay로 실수를 피하려는 단계만 있고 ‘cannot do it’이 나오지 않은 자리라 since의 원인이 없고, 뒤 문장의 believing 논증이 끊긴다.
wrongOptionExplanations.3: cannot은 앞에서 나와 표면상 맞지만, 직후 (You are correct.)를 확신 문장과 분리해 부모 고리가 깨지고 종료(quit)가 너무 이르게 선다.
wrongOptionExplanations.5: 죽음 소용돌이 요약이 이미 끝난 뒤에 다시 quit를 넣으면 반복·역행이 되고, since cannot도 이미 먼 과거 사건이 되어 인과가 성립하지 않는다.

accepted.explanation: 주어진 문장의 since you cannot do…는 직전 ‘cannot do it.(You are correct.)’만이 제공하는 확신에 유일하게 걸려 앞 고리를 닫고, 직후 소용돌이 서술(…you stall; you quit)이 그 결과(you quit)를 패턴으로 받아 뒤 고리를 동시에 닫는다. 다른 자리에서는 선행사 부재나 부모 고리·순서 단절이 생긴다.
keyPoints: since·cannot 같은 인과·어휘 사슬이 직전 문장에만 존재하는지 확인한다
주어진 문장이 직후 문장의 전제(quit 요약)를 공급하는지도 함께 본다
표면 키워드만 겹치는 자리는 논리 순서가 깨지면 오답이다
accepted.omittedSourceSentence: Believing that your work should be perfect, you gradually become convinced that you cannot do it. (You are correct.) Sooner or later, since you cannot do what you are trying to do, you quit.
accepted.passageWithMarkers: To require perfection is to invite paralysis. ① The pattern is predictable: as you see error in what you have done, you steer your work toward what you imagine you can do perfectly. ② You cling ever more tightly to what you already know you can do ― away from risk and exploration, and possibly further from the work of your heart. ③ You find reasons to delay, since to not work is to not make mistakes. ④ And in one of those little ironies of life, only the pattern itself achieves perfection ― a perfect death spiral: you misdirect your work; you stall; you quit. ⑤

sentences: In highly representational paintings, plays, or stories, the focus is on subject matter that resembles everyday life and the role of background style is to facilitate the construction of mental models.
In highly expressionist works, novel stylistic devices work in an inharmonious manner against the subject matter thereby creating a disquieting atmosphere.
Indeed, this disquieting atmosphere enables the viewer or reader to rely on conventional forms so that the work remains easily interpreted without an aesthetic attitude.

Thus, when the work is less "readable" (or easily interpreted), its departure from conventional forms reminds the viewer or reader that an "aesthetic attitude" is needed to appreciate the whole episode.
An ability to switch between the "pragmatic attitude" of everyday life and an "aesthetic attitude" is fundamental to a balanced life.

wrongOptionExplanations.②: 표현주의 작품에서 양식이 소재와 불협화하여 불안한 분위기를 만든다는 대비 축을 제시해 다음 ‘덜 읽힘’ 논의로 자연스럽게 이어진다.
wrongOptionExplanations.④: 덜 읽히는 작품이 관습 형식 이탈로 미적 태도를 요청한다는 핵심 과정을 설명해 깊이 있는 처리로 이어지는 고리이다.
wrongOptionExplanations.⑤: 일상적 실용 태도와 미적 태도 간 전환이 균형 잡힌 삶의 토대라는 글의 결론을 담당한다.

accepted.explanation: 글은 재현적 작품(소재·정신 모형 중심)과 표현주의 작품(양식·소재의 불협화로 덜 읽힘)을 대비한 뒤, 후자가 미적 태도를 요청하고 깊이 있는 성찰을 가능하게 하며 끝단에서 태도의 전환을 균형의 조건으로 맺는다. ‘Indeed, this disquieting atmosphere…’로 시작하는 문장은 앞 문장의 어휘(disquieting atmosphere, stylistic 관련)를 이어 ‘쉽게 해석되고 미적 태도가 필요 없다’고 평가를 뒤집어 후속 ‘aesthetic attitude is needed’ 논리와 충돌한다. 그 문장만 빼면 ‘disquieting atmosphere’ 뒤의 ‘Thus, when the work is less “readable”…’가 빈틈없이 이어진다.
keyPoints: 재현 vs 표현의 대비 축과 ‘덜 읽힘→미적 태도’의 인과 흐름을 확인한다
앞 문장 어휘·지시어로 이어진 척하지만 평가·인과 방향만 뒤집힌 문장을 골라낸다
